[assistant] - [Critical] .claude/settings.local.json:43 — `Bash(git *)` allowlist permits destructive git operations like `git reset --hard`/`git clean` variants that can bypass the narrower deny patterns.
- [High] .claude/settings.local.json:48 — `Bash(codex exec *)` grants arbitrary Codex command execution, including potentially unsafe sandbox/approval options.
- [High] .claude/settings.local.json:66 — `Bash(pip3 install *)` allows arbitrary package installation and setup hooks, creating a code-execution supply-chain risk.
- [High] .claude/settings.local.json:90 — `Bash(.../.venv/bin/python *)` allows arbitrary Python script/module execution from the workspace.
- [Medium] .claude/settings.local.json:119 — hook command hardcodes `/Users/hoon/workTree/agent-factory`, so cloned/moved worktrees silently lose SessionStart/UserPrompt/Stop/SessionEnd hook behavior.
